fixtureScope: Exact source fixture declarations; runner case models its recording numerically, not its DOM/capture lifecycle.

measurements.label: Clipped samples in the test tones

threshold.title: Distortion is high
threshold.meaning: THD+N above 0.3 % at 1 kHz is audible as harshness. The output stage, a gain setting that is too hot, or the capture chain may be at fault.
threshold.action: Lower the unit’s master/trim level, retest with the loopback calibration, and compare against a known-good device.

threshold.title: Noise floor is high
threshold.meaning: Signal-to-noise below 70 dB means hiss or interference is close to audible in quiet passages.
threshold.action: Check cables and grounding, move away from power supplies, and test the unit’s other outputs.

threshold.title: Channel separation is poor
threshold.meaning: Signal leaks from one channel into the other, which narrows the stereo image and can indicate a failing stage or a bad cable.
threshold.action: Swap cables, retest, and inspect the output jacks.

threshold.title: Left and right levels differ
threshold.meaning: A channel imbalance above 0.5 dB shifts the stereo image.
threshold.action: Check the balance setting and the output pots or faders; compare cables.

threshold.title: Frequency response is not flat
threshold.meaning: The level changes by more than 1 dB between 100 Hz and 10 kHz, so the output is audibly tilted or filtered.
threshold.action: Check EQ, filter and isolator positions are neutral, then retest.

threshold.title: Output compresses at higher levels
threshold.meaning: The gain changes by more than 0.5 dB between −40 and −12 dBFS: a limiter, soft-clip or failing stage is active.
threshold.action: Turn off limiters/effects and retest at a lower level.

threshold.title: Dropouts or glitches detected
threshold.meaning: The steady tone was interrupted. Buffer under-runs, USB problems or a loose connector cause this.
threshold.action: Use a direct USB port, raise the buffer size and re-seat the cable.

threshold.title: Polarity is inverted
threshold.meaning: A channel is out of phase with the digital signal; mixed with a correct channel, bass cancels.
threshold.action: Check for a miswired cable or output; correct the wiring.

threshold.title: The capture clipped
threshold.meaning: The recording input overloaded, so the distortion figures are not valid.
threshold.action: Lower the input gain on the recording interface and rerun.
